story: After the first rest day, Stage 11 around Toulouse turned into a fast and chaotic race. A strong breakaway survived relentless attacks from the peloton, while Mathieu van der Poel launched a late chase in pursuit of the leaders. Up front, Jonas Abrahamsen outsprinted Mauro Schmid to take the biggest victory of his career. The day also featured late drama when Tadej Pogačar crashed with just a few kilometres remaining, but his rivals eased the pace and allowed him to rejoin, leaving the general classification unchanged.
